parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({name: $('Montar HTML Telefonia').item.json.titulo, content: $('Montar HTML Telefonia').item.json.html, type: 1, status: 1, urgency: $('Montar HTML Telefonia').item.json.prioridade, impact: 2, priority: $('Montar HTML Telefonia').item.json.prioridade, category: $('Montar HTML Telefonia').item.json.itilcategories_id, request_type: 3}) }}

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO glpi_n8n.chamados_log
  (conversa_id, glpi_ticket_id, glpi_ticket_url, titulo, menu_numero, menu_descricao,
   solicitante_nome, solicitante_email, solicitante_matricula, secretaria, coordenadoria,
   glpi_category_id, prioridade, resposta_glpi)
VALUES (
  $1, $2,
  'https://suporte.araraquara.sp.gov.br/front/ticket.form.php?id=' || $2::text,
  $3, $4, $5,
  $6, $7, $8, $9, $10,
  $11, 2, '{}'::jsonb
) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING;
